description: Screens a debt-recovery matter from the creditor’s side using its basic facts — amount, security, instrument, debtor type, place and stage — and sets out which recovery routes the facts point to (SARFAESI enforcement, a DRT original application, an IBC application, a cheque-dishonour complaint), the DRT bench and DRAT for the place, the statutory periods relevant at the current stage, and whether the matter meets the minimum claim size for engagement. Use when a lender, company or individual wants a first view of the options for recovering a debt.

asking_as.description: Who is asking: a bank, an NBFC, an asset reconstruction company (ARC), a company, an individual, or an advocate seeking empanelment

city.description: City relevant to the matter, used to find the DRT bench (e.g. "Pune")

claim_inr.description: Amount claimed or in default, in rupees (e.g. 25000000 for ₹2.5 crore)

instrument.description: What the claim rests on: a loan or credit facility, a dishonoured cheque, a guarantee, an unpaid invoice for goods or services, or something else

security.description: Whether the debt is secured by a security interest (mortgage, hypothecation, charge), unsecured, or partly secured

stage.description: Where the matter stands: "default_no_action" = default has occurred; no notice or proceedings yet; "notice_issued" = a demand or legal notice has been issued (for example a SARFAESI s.13(2) notice or a cheque-dishonour notice); "enforcement_underway" = SARFAESI measures (possession, sale) are under way; "proceedings_pending" = proceedings are pending before a tribunal or court; "order_received" = an order, decree or recovery certificate has been received; "other" = none of these

state.description: State, if no city is given (e.g. "Rajasthan")

name: screen_recovery_matter
title: Screen a debt-recovery matter
